purpose: One contract, two implementations (#468). The FastAPI research path computed writing dynamics from input telemetry and was never deployed; the Next.js production path stored the same telemetry and analysed none of it, while blesc.jp described noticing changes in how a student writes relative to their own past. Production now runs a TypeScript port. Both are pinned here so they cannot disagree about what a pause, a rewrite or a change against a student's own baseline is.
notes: Expected values in this file are generated by running the backend implementation (scripts/generate_writing_dynamics_conformance.py), not written by hand.

Rounding is Python's: round-half-even at the third and sixth decimal, and for the percentile index. The TypeScript port reproduces it, so values are compared with a tolerance of 1e-9 and the tie cases are expected to match exactly.

change_z_threshold (2.0) and min_field_inputs (5) are engineering choices, not measured values. Nothing in this repository has measured how often a student's own writing moves two standard deviations on an ordinary day.
Below ramp_up_days qualifying days there is no comparison, as for the graph baseline (#91). Days whose only entries have fewer than min_field_inputs edits do not count.
Standard deviation is the population one, floored at min_std. A feature constant across the window is reported in degenerate_features and never as a change.
The output carries z_scores and baseline statistics for research. The educator surface receives only `changes` (feature and direction), never a z-score (docs/educator_display_policy.md).

dynamics_cases.name: production_collector_shape
dynamics_cases.why: The payload EntryTelemetryCollector sends: metrics present for every touched field, step_change and submit_failed events naming fields of their own.

dynamics_cases.name: events_only_no_field_metrics
dynamics_cases.why: Every `x or fallback` branch: pauses from the 1500 ms rule, revisions from metadata.delta, final length from the last input event.

dynamics_cases.name: percentile_index_half_even
dynamics_cases.why: Six intervals put the p90 index at round(4.5). Python rounds that to 4; Math.round would pick 5.

dynamics_cases.name: unsorted_float_times_zero_length
dynamics_cases.why: Events out of order, a float relative_ms (int() truncates), a value_length of 0 falling through to char_count, and a field whose metrics are not an object.

dynamics_cases.name: rounding_ties_half_even
dynamics_cases.why: An exact binary half at the third decimal (chars_per_minute) and at the sixth (deletion_ratio). Python rounds both to even.

dynamics_cases.name: empty_session
dynamics_cases.why: Nothing collected. No fields, not a field of zeroes.

change_cases.name: cold_start_day_one
change_cases.why: A first entry. There is no baseline, so there is no comparison and no change: the refusal is the contract.

change_cases.name: thirteen_days_is_not_enough
change_cases.why: One day short of the ramp. Still nothing, exactly as the graph baseline.

change_cases.name: an_ordinary_day_is_within_baseline
change_cases.why: Fourteen ordinary days and a fifteenth like them. No change is reported.

change_cases.name: longer_hesitation_is_observed
change_cases.why: The longest pause and the share of pauses both well above this student's own range. Both reported, larger |z| first.

change_cases.name: shorter_slower_writing_is_observed_as_lower
change_cases.why: Less written, and more slowly. Direction 'lower', never a judgement about why.

change_cases.name: more_rewriting_is_observed
change_cases.why: Deletions per edit far above the student's own rate: the 'wrote it and took it back' signal.

change_cases.name: a_feature_that_never_moved_is_degenerate_not_a_change
change_cases.why: Fourteen days without a single deletion, then some. With no spread the z-score is the change over a floor constant, so it is listed as degenerate and NOT reported (cf. #85).

change_cases.name: short_entries_do_not_count_toward_the_baseline
change_cases.why: Three days whose only entry was pasted or dictated (fewer than min_field_inputs edits) sit inside the window. They are skipped, and observed_days counts the fourteen that qualify.

change_cases.name: a_short_entry_today_is_not_compared
change_cases.why: A baseline exists, but today's entry has too few edits to say anything about how it was written.

change_cases.name: several_entries_on_one_day_are_averaged
change_cases.why: A day with two qualifying entries contributes their mean; a non-qualifying second entry is ignored.

change_cases.name: only_the_most_recent_fourteen_days_are_the_window
change_cases.why: Twenty days of history, the oldest six extreme. History is most recent first and the window stops at fourteen qualifying days, so the old extremes never enter it.

change_cases.name: the_collector_session_end_to_end
change_cases.why: Today's features are the production_collector_shape output, as the route computes them, compared with fourteen ordinary days.
